About the College
SARAIGHAT COLLEGE is one of the premier Higher Educational Institutions in greater Changsari area of Kamrup (Rural) District, Assam. Situated near the National Highway (NH-31), the college is well connected with other major parts of the region. Since its inception, the college has been working with a missionary zeal to promote higher education amongst the rural population of the area with special emphasis on the socio-economically marginalized sections of the society. In its relentless service, the institution has so far experienced various hazards and challenges but has successfully managed to overcome them.

Saraighat College situated at Changsari (Kamrup, Assam) in the Northern Bank of the mighty River Brahmaputra is imparting higher education since its establishment in 1981. Our motto as embodied in the college emblem is "na hi jnanena sadrsam pavitram iha vidyate" i.e. Nothing in this world is as pure as Knowledge. Keeping with this spirit, the college is striving hard to disseminate knowledge to its students and enable them to grow and flourish as socially responsible individuals. It gives me immense pleasure to welcome all the students, guardians, stakeholders and well wishers to this institution.
Education in Saraighat College incorporates both classroom teaching as well as field based exercises to broaden the learners'  thought process and enable them to cope with rapidly changing needs and demands of the present times. It is our endeavour to advance the profession of education through application of best practices in teaching-learning along with effective usage of modern technology to make the academic environment more learner centric and contemporary in nature.
Let us join hands and work together towards making the college a centre of academic excellence, let us develop each student as a prospective human resource and through it commit to making the world a better place to live and learn.
Facilities
Admission
The college offers online admission facilities to the prospective and incumbent students.
Administration
Administrative Office is situated at the ground floor of the administrative block for the convenience of the In-house staff as well as visitors and differently-abled. The office functions both manually and digitally with increased thrust on digitisization of the administrative mechanism
Book Bank
The College Central Library and Departmental libraries offers book bank facilities to the needy students. Students can borrow text books and reference materials from the bank.
College Library
The Central Library of the college is well-equipped with state of the art modern IT facilities like OPAC, NLIST membership for e-resources and is fully automated with INFLIBNET SOUL 2.0 software. The library is stocked with approximately 15000 books, reference books, journals, magazines etc along with e-books and e-journals.
Hostel
College offers hostel facilities to the girl student with an accommodation capacity of  30 girls
Seminar Hall
The Seminar Hall is well equipped with audio-visual and public address system. It has a capacity of 150 persons.
ICT and Smart Classrooms
To promote blended learning there are facilities for imparting ICT enabled lectures in smart classrooms equipped with internet and audio-visual aids.
Computer Lab
A computer lab is in operation with 19 computers with internet facilities.
Language Lab
Language lab facilitates the learners to avail a space for language learning where students can access the audio visual tools of language learning
Multi-Gym
The college fraternity can avail the facilities of the multi-gym to boost their physical health and well being
Career Counselling Cell
The Cell generates awareness amongst students regarding various employment opportunities and career guidance for placement facilities in government and non-government instituions. It organises different career development programmes with the help of experts from different fields.
Rest Rooms for Students
Boys common room and Girls common room for rest and recreation are available for the students. Facilities like Table Tennis, Carrom, Chess are provideded in the rooms. A sanitary vending machine is also installed for the girl students keeping in view their menstrual need and hygiene.
Classrooms and Laboratories
The college has adequate classrooms for Honours and General Courses. Every Department has their individual classrooms for Honours students. Departments with practicals have their own laboratories replete with necessary tools and equipments.
Feedback and Grievance Redressal
Student Satisfaction Survey has been introduced for effective teaching-learning evaluation. Anti-ragging and grievance redressal mechanisms are incorporated to ensure a healthy atmosphere in the campus.
Indoor Stadium
The Indoor stadium houses a well maintained badminton court for the benefit of college student and staff
Teachers Common Room
Central as well as Departmental Common Rooms for teachers are provided with adequate facilities of Internet connection and open accessibility of e-resources.
Canteen
The College canteen operates during the college hours and provides hygienic snacks and meals at nominal cost to the college fraternity and visitors.
Wi-Fi facility
The college campus is Wi-Fi enabled with high speed internet facility.
Waste Management
The Vermicompost unit of the college is constructed for the recycle and reuse of bio-degradable waste generated in the campus. The manure generated in the Vermicompost unit is used in the college garden to increase the soil fertility. For a clean and green campus, the college has installed safe disposal bins at various points and discourages the use of plastic in the premises.
